title: Retail CRM Team Leader (VLTs)
description:
We are #OPAP
We are Greece’s leading gaming company, with 65 years of history and Top Employer in Greece for 2023 & 2024. Our vision is to provide best-in-class entertainment in both retail and online, as well as to give back to society.
OPAP’s Fast Forward strategy guides our aspirations of delivering affordable and personalized entertainment experiences, while building an agile and dynamic company that enjoys long-term success. Customer centricity, digital orientation, agility, people engagement and social contribution are part of our DNA!
 
So what’s the challenge...
 
Are you ready to drive the transformation of customer relationships and boost engagement? As CRM Team Leader, you'll turn our Retail CRM Strategy into a dynamic and impactful plan that enhances customer value and engagement throughout their lifecycle.
 
Your day to day will include:
 

Implementing the CRM strategy for Retail Games to boost customer value and engagement
Collaborating with Sales, Product, Loyalty, and Retail Experience teams to align on roadmap and plan
Reviewing and refining the Retail CRM plan for mass and targeted campaigns, recommending audience segments, reward value, mechanisms, and channels, and finalizing the plan for approval
Designing automated lifecycle journeys (welcome, upsell, cross-sell, retention & reactivation) and offering tailored promotions at each stage
Proposing CRM plans utilizing new reward mechanisms (real-time triggers & missions) and conducting A/B testing
Analyzing the cost/benefit of the monthly CRM plan, including communication and OPEX budgets, in relation to targets
Monitoring and presenting performance against KPIs providing insights and proposing automations 
Optimizing campaign management operations to reduce human error and increase efficiency, team capacity, and agility

 
What you need to succeed: 
 

BSc in Business Administration, Marketing, Mathematics, or other relevant field
6+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role within a fast-paced organization 
Understanding of sophisticated customer segmentation & experience on defining segmented campaigns
Ability to understand the CRM ecosystem and data infrastructure 
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud or other CRM tools (Siebel CRM, Unica, Responsys, Optimove) is preferable
Team player with agility and adaptability 
Effective organizational and planning skills to deal with a variety of projects
People management skills
Business Acumen
Analytical skills with strong attention to detail 
Ability to work under pressure and deliver with high quality within strict timeframes
Strong communication and presentation skills both in Greek and English languages
Advanced MS Office skills, particularly in MS Excel 

What’s in it for you?

An award-winning working environment 🚀
State of the art facilities including gym & restaurant 🏢
Hybrid working model 💻
Competitive salary package and bonus scheme 💸
Health insurance coverage & Pension Plan 🙏
Monthly food allowance 🍴
Continuous learning with classroom/digital trainings by OpapAcademy 🎓
Internal Career Opportunities 💼
Well-Being Activities 💪

 
OPAP Group is an equal opportunity employer
 
Does this sound like you? If yes, we would love to meet you!

title: SALES SUPPORT- Orthopedics
description:
He/she is responsible for compiling Daily Sales Reports and assembling the sales schedule (surgeries, doctor visits, presentations).
Records leave reports of the department's personnel and informs the supervisor.
Compiles and processes the Department Incident Charges, regarding non-billables.
He is responsible for opening new product codes in ERP
Sends sales/purchases statistics according to the needs of each sales department.
Corrects incident data in ERP. Match charges to invoices. On a weekly basis, he receives the data from the sellers regarding the sales, so that the necessary corrections can be made to the incidents (doctor's name, seller's name, category of operations, etc.)
Performs inventory control via ERP and informs vendors and supervisor of inventory and warehouse and overstock expiration dates. As for back orders and delays in receiving goods.
Notifies sellers of product descriptions approved by Product Manager and BUM.
Monitors sales prices, and matches products in the price watch, in collaboration with the Product Manager and BUM.
Communicates with hospital supply departments to inform them regarding delivery of backorders, vantage code project, etc.
Communicates with domestic suppliers to process Expense requests for surgical consumables.
Prepares and participates in monthly sales meetings.
He/she is responsible for extracting the records of the hospital records for processing their inventory and sending them to the involved/interested members of the B.U. as defined by the company based on the procedure (monthly and quarterly inventories of deposits with code, description, pieces, lot number, expiration date), as well as for the collection and formatting of the inventoried materials, data processing and sending them to invoicing.

title: Housekeeping Manager - Omesberg, Lech, Austria
description:

Ensures sufficient room inventory is available and cleaned to maximize revenue.

Must be able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Dynamic and highly professional environment
Continuous learning and development opportunities
Friendly work environment

title: Executive Assistant
description:
SABO is a Greek manufacturing company, based in Vassiliko, Evia, Greece, with subsidiaries in Brazil, Romania and Italy and we operate in more than 50 countries. For 40 years we have supported our customers’ growth by providing turnkey and integrated solutions in the fields of heavy clay, industrial solutions, solid waste management, power and automation, heavy industry and shipping.
Our successful operation is based on the technical know-how, innovative mindset and collaboration spirit of our team who is committed to making a global impact.
This highly motivated team needs to be strengthened by an Executive Assistant.
Your role in more detail:
As Executive Assistant, you will:

Coordinate and manage our CEOs’ personal calendar, including scheduling appointments, events, and personal commitments, managing shared folders and sending invitations
Perform general administrative tasks (e.g., taking detailed notes, preparing meeting materials, preparing, and submitting expense reports) and special projects
Arrange travel accommodations, transportation, and itineraries for trips
Prepare and modify documents, including correspondence, reports, presentations, spreadsheets, memos and emails
Act as the point of contact among executives, employees, clients and other external partners
Collaborate with other departments to follow up and facilitate cross-functional projects and decisions
Oversee general office operations to ensure a well-maintained and efficient working environment

Your Qualifications:

BSc in Business Administration, Communications, Social Sciences, or related field
More than 3 years of working experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role, ideally within an industrial environment
Familiarity with calendar management and travel coordination for executives
Very good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint
Fluency in both English and Greek (oral and written at professional corporate level)
Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion
Strong organizational and time management skills
Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and situations

Your Benefits:

The opportunity to gain global experience and work with a highly motivated team
A motivating and engaging work environment
Continuous learning and career development opportunities
Competitive compensation package
Private life & health insurance

 
With DEI in mind
Diversity, equity, and inclusion are a priority for us! SABO ensures a safe and balanced working environment, based on respect by providing an equal number of opportunities to every employee who meets the necessary requirements.
 
Here @SABO, we care for your privacy. The security of your data is one of our greatest concerns. All information is strictly confidential and in accordance with GDPR rules.
 
 
Meet our hiring team…and APPLY NOW 😊

title: Payments Risk Operations Specialist
description: Etraveli Group is the globally leading company for tech solutions and fulfillment capabilities for online sales of flights. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We hold consumer online travel agency brands like Mytrip, GoToGate & Flight Network and serve Booking.com with flights. Etraveli Group has also established strategic partnerships with companies like Skyscanner, Google Flights, TUI, etc. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 2400 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Our major offices are in Sweden (HQ), Canada, Greece, India, Poland with the Athens office being one of the largest, hosting around 580 employees working from the center of Athens for the rest of the world. Join us and start as Payments Risk Operations Specialist in the Risk Management team!Position SummaryIf you are captivated by mind games, you possess strong investigation skills and can see patterns behind numbers and scattered pieces of information, it’s highly likely that Payments Risk Operations Specialist would be your dream job!As a Payments Risk Operations Specialist your main responsibility will be to protect Etraveli Group from financial losses due to fraudulent activities while maintaining sales and customer experience in top performance. Besides screening high risk transactions, this role should also propose innovative improvements in existing processes. The ideal candidate must have excellent investigation, problem solving and decision making skills and is expected to be up-to-date with the latest online fraud trends as well as with potential fraud screening tools.Responsibilities Screen potentially high-risk transactions accurately and in a timely manner utilizing a wide range of fraud prevention systems, tools and reports. Identify fraud patterns or abnormalities and take appropriate actions to prevent similar activities and mitigate potential future fraud. Thoroughly process and analyze fraud alerts received from external sources. Ensure transaction authenticity by contacting customers via phone and/or email. Propose innovative improvements to our existing processes, aiming to further enhance our fraud prevention and detection strategies Deliver dynamic tasks & provide support for a wide range of business analyses. Stay up to date with the latest online fraud trends, practices, and tools through continuous learning & research. Be a problem-solver. Requirements Bachelor’s degree and/or studies preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics. Excellent command of the English language. Advanced experience with MS office (especially Excel) Data driven approach along with strong critical, analytical and investigation skills. Ability to act proactively, take initiatives and demonstrate a can-do attitude focusing on producing high quality results within a fast-paced environment. Team player with strong interpersonal and communication skills including the ability to effectively interact with clients.  Work independently, meet tight deadlines while navigating multiple systems and processes Discretion in dealing with confidential information. High level of responsibility & integrity combined with eagerness to work in a multicultural, international environment subject to continuous changes. Previous work experience as a Fraud Analyst will be considered a plus  Availability to work on shifts around the clock (24/7) – 8-hour shifts, 5 days per week including weekends and bank holidays.  BenefitsWe are looking for people who would make the world smaller for travelers but want a bigger world of opportunities for themselves. With us you can enjoy: #LI-Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility! Health Benefits - Through partners we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need. Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece. Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Ambelokipi Metro station. Growth – We believe in personal development and continuous education, thus we offer the opportunity of role-related training on tools and best practices. We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space! We have a relaxed & fun work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast coffee/tea, playing ping pong or video games.  At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

The essentials of the position include, but are not limited to, the following duties:▪ Initiate and develop comprehensive “Energy Transition Technologies” insights, to support senior leadership in making business decisions related to the company's strategy, technology and R&D activities, and aligning those activities with business priorities.▪ Support the proposal process from opportunity to handoff to the Sales team in key RFQs.▪ Contribute to several heat transfer focused projects and assist in key heat exchanger technology initiatives.▪ Lead product development on several development projects, working as member of the R&D department team.▪ Evaluate the design and performance of the newly developed equipment; ensure deliverability and reliability of suppliers to meet specifications and timetable.▪ Expand professional and technical knowledge by reviewing professional and scientific publications and expanding personal networks with potential clients, vendors and internal teams.▪ Provide support to design teams to ensure proper application of new heat transfer technologies with an end-goal to introduce these technologies to manufacturing operations.▪ Assist in the commercialization of the newly developed company products.▪ Plan and coordinate the manufacturing of engineered samples and pilot runs if needed.▪ Support pre-sales activities as needed.▪ Generate written technical proposals, summary reports and standard work instructions.▪ Work with technical department and other departments personnel to implement the most promising opportunities.▪ Conduct presentations for engineering, technical department, and business personnel.Requirements:1. A degree in Chemical Engineering is preferred but consideration will be given to other engineering degrees (i.e Mechanical Engineering) based on actual relevant experience.2.
